items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: the regular rhythm section consists of White Newman piano, Lawrence Morale banjo, Eddie Morale bass, and myself drums.

ctx.x: I'll leave this over there on tip on that. All right. That's all right. You can't hear it. You're talking about Bebe originally. Yeah, you know. And Papa Celestan.

Well, that time he used to...that we had the original Tuxedo Band. And then we used the title of the Young Tuxedo Band. Now that outfit consists of Dwight Newman on piano, and we had trained over to Paul Bent on trombone, Dennis Harris on saxophone and clarinet, Louis Contrell on saxophone and tenor sax and clarinet. And the regular rhythm section consists of White Newman piano, Lawrence Morale banjo, Eddie Morale bass, and myself drums. That was the regular rhythm. Eight pieces out.
What kind of a drum set did you get in the beginning?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Eddie Morrell, which is my cousin, on the bass, Lawrence Morrell on the banjo, and I was on the drum.

ctx.x: And the Pack House that was located on the court had the restaurant and ball and pool table downstairs. They called it, they was run by this fella by the name of Faubacher. And this fella, Bebe, William Ridgely's brother, he was the manager of the place. I think I don't know, remember his name? His first name? Yeah, his first name was Bebe Ridgely, his first name, he was a big tall, brown skin, heavy built man. But he was the manager of that place there, I can't think of his first name. But all I can tell you,…
What's the name of that band?

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Well, we started together. It was Josiah on drum.

ctx.x: Well, we started together. It was Josiah on drum. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Raymond Brown on trambone. Bushall on the corner of his age. And, um, Lawrence on the bench. Oh yeah, Louis Conqueror was named. From a boy.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Lawrence Morrell, Aidan Morrell, NFL man they called, uh, we had Raymond Brown first, trombone player. Oh yeah. Myself on the drum.

ctx.x: Uh, who did you start playing with? Who, who did you start playing with?

Well we made a band up. A fella by the name of All My Cousins, Bush Hall, trumpet, Paul Ball. He just had got a saxophone. Uh huh. Lawrence Morrell, Aidan Morrell, NFL man they called, uh, we had Raymond Brown first, trombone player. Oh yeah. Myself on the drum. And we named that band. First the name we had called it, called it the Golden Rules, uh, Jazz Band, Golden Rule. Uh huh. Lawrence was manager, Bush Hall was leader. Oh.
That was more of a family band.
